apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 209 adds Screen resolution, 1.5× and 2× stream-dimension upscaling targets for MetalFX/NIS/FSR1. For 2560×1080, multipliers render 3840×1620 or 5120×2160 then fit to screen. Incoming resolution stays unchanged. Removes frame interpolation and Balanced pacing; restores newest-real-frame rendering. Retains adaptive HDR and Metal 4/controller fixes. Simulator/GPU checks and Release archive passed. Physical performance needs testing. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
